talk.gap: Prior internal write-ups reported average gains only, with no breakdown by query type.
talk.limitations: Single domain, 400 queries, one model family; hand-checked keys were scored by the author, not blinded.
talk.method: Built a 400-query testbed in Python, split by query type; compared no-retrieval vs two retrievers; measured answer accuracy against hand-checked keys.
talk.next: Blinded re-scoring and a second domain before claiming the effect generalizes.
talk.problem: Small teams add retrieval to LLM apps assuming it always helps; in the testbed it sometimes made answers worse.
talk.result: Retrieval raised accuracy 18 points on factoid queries but cut it 9 points on multi-hop queries in this testbed (n=400, hand-checked keys).
talk.title: When does retrieval hurt? Negative transfer in small RAG systems (TEST)
